data.title: Israel-bound plane diverted after co-pilot stabs captain
data.description: JERUSALEM - The co-pilot of a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv tried to crash the plane after stabbing the pilot, but passengers ​then held him ⁠down while other pilots landed the plane safely in Saudi Arabia, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Wednesday.

data.title: China opens ‘military support centre’ in Laos
data.description: ⁠China has opened ​a new military support and training centre in ​Laos, the Ministry ‌of National Defence said in Beijing as it announced a rare overseas expansion.

data.title: ‘The Cycle’ is a marriage of ‘Silent Hill’ and ‘Evil Dead’
data.description: If The Cycle is on your watchlist, it might be that you saw Stephen King’s tweet, recommending horror heads to put this “special” on the calendar. Otherwise, this independent werewolf horror film has been flying under the radar, with a very limited release, a worn-out werewolf story and, not least, a poster that looks extremely generic.

data.title: Man City future in doubt after guilty ruling
data.description: MANCHESTER, England - Manchester City face an uncertain future after being found guilty of more than 100 breaches of Premier League financial rules in a bombshell ruling that former player Micah Richards described as “devastating”.

data.title: Northern Ireland police probe blockade of divisive parade
data.description: PORTADOWN, Northern Ireland - The police chief of Northern Ireland said Wednesday a criminal probe was under way into protests blocking a pro-British Protestant parade through a mainly Catholic area, as the standoff dragged into a fourth day despite ongoing talks.

data.title: Israel-bound plane diverted after cockpit stabbing
data.description: JERUSALEM - The co-pilot ‌of a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv is believed to have stabbed the captain in a possible attempted “terror attack” on Wednesday, forcing the plane to divert to Saudi Arabia where it landed safely, three Israeli officials said.

data.title: British PM reopens debate on rejoining EU
data.description: LONDON - Andy Burnham put the idea of Britain rejoining the EU on the table on Wednesday, breaking a taboo for a British prime minister and reopening the divisive Brexit debate.

data.title: Russia targets Kyiv power supply as winter approaches
data.description: KYIV - Russia hit Ukrainian energy infrastructure in a wave of deadly drone and missile strikes on Wednesday, prompting an urgent call for civil contingencies as freezing winter approaches.

data.title: ‘Do something,’ begs Iranian woman facing death sentence
data.description: An Iranian woman sentenced to death over protests in Iran earlier this year has begged the international community to save her life and others facing the death penalty, according to an audio message from prison shared by rights groups on Wednesday.

data.title: Only 18% of 10,000-bag backlog cleared at Suvarnabhumi
data.description: A total of 10,000 pieces of luggage piled up at Suvarnabhumi airport between Sept 26 and 28 as a result of flooding and operational failures by Thai Airways International, with only 18% cleared as of Wednesday, according to Transport Minister Phiphat Ratchakitprakarn.

data.title: Thai Banks Resilient but Bad-Debt Overhang Persists, Fitch Warns
data.description: Lenders have curbed risk appetite and profits are resilient, but Fitch expects the NPL ratio to stay at 3-4% for the next one to two years

data.title: Israel-bound plane rerouted after cockpit fight
data.description: TABUK, Saudi Arabia - Two pilots were wounded after they reportedly fought on board the plane they were flying from Dubai to Tel Aviv, and which was forced to make an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday.

data.title: PM defends handing out cash to flood victims
data.description: Sparking online debate after being captured on a Facebook live stream , Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul was seen handing out cash to flood-hit residents of communities in Sai Mai district of Bangkok late on Tuesday.

data.title: Pattaya prosecutors indict duo in Russian siblings’ deaths
data.description: PATTAYA - Pattaya prosecutors have indicted ex-convict Thana Kerdthong and his alleged accomplice on nine charges including murder in the deaths of two Russian siblings whose bodies were found buried in Bang Lamung district of Chon Buri in late July.

data.title: Nonthaburi raises red flags, reinforces flood barriers
data.description: Nonthaburi Municipality has raised red flags warning of critically high water levels and ordered sandbags to strengthen a 10-kilometre-long flood barrier along the Chao Phraya River following an increase in water discharge rates from the Chao Phraya dam in Chai Nat province.

data.title: Thai Airways suspends cargo intake amid flood disruption
data.description: Thai Airways International has announced a temporary suspension of inbound, outbound and transit cargo acceptance at its cargo terminal at Suvarnabhumi Airport from Oct 1-6 due to flooding disrupting staff travel and warehouse operations.

data.title: Swedish truth commission on Sami people seeks redress
data.description: STOCKHOLM - A Swedish truth commission on Wednesday urged the state to apologise for injustices committed against its indigenous Sami people, including assimilation programmes, and provide compensation and redress.

data.title: Turkey freezes ex-minister's assets as fund crisis grows
data.description: ISTANBUL — Turkish prosecutors have moved to freeze the assets of a top governing party official and former minister who resigned at the weekend over allegations she profited from an investment fund crisis.

data.title: Tourist rafts, hundreds of fish cages hit Mae Klong dam
data.description: KANCHANABURI - A salvage operation was under way on Wednesday after strong currents on the storm-swollen Mae Klong river sent several tourist rafts and hundreds of fish cages smashing into the Mae Klong dam in Tha Muang district.

data.title: HRH Princess Sirindhorn presides over 12th National Vaccine Conference Awards
data.description: The National Vaccine Institute (NVI) organised the 12th National Vaccine Conference to promote and strengthen the capabilities of the country's vaccine workforce, while fostering networks and collaboration at both individual and organisational levels.

data.title: Bangkok luxury housing outpaces major global cities
data.description: Bangkok luxury home prices have risen 75% in 10 years, outpacing several global cities, while a 3.8% rental yield keeps the market attractive in Asia-Pacific.

data.title: Move along tabis, Margiela has six toes now
data.description: Havaianas’ latest fashion collaboration has added something no flip-flop really needs: a sixth toe.

data.title: Storm-fed plankton bloom seen around Koh Lan
data.description: PATTAYA — The sea around Koh Lan, a popular island destination just off Pattaya in Chon Buri province, turned green on Wednesday, surprising some tourists unfamiliar with the phenomenon of a plankton bloom following heavy rainfall.

data.title: Moxy Bangkok Ratchaprasong Earns 4-Leaf Green Leaf Sustainability Standard
data.description: 30 September 2026 - Bangkok, Thailand - Moxy Bangkok Ratchaprasong , Thailand’s first and Asia Pacific’s largest Moxy hotel, has been awarded the 4-Leaf Green Leaf Sustainability Standard for Hotels by the Green Leaf Foundation , marking a new milestone in the hotel’s commitment to more responsible hospitality.

data.title: More rain forecast next week
data.description: More thundershowers are expected across Thailand between Sunday and Tuesday, with Bangkok and vicinity also warned of downpours, according to the Meterological Department.

data.title: What we know about the North Korean POW dispute
data.description: SEOUL — The transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war (POWs) from Ukraine to South Korea has sparked a rare public diplomatic row between Seoul and Kyiv.

data.title: Julie Kegels drops the crotch low this spring
data.description: For her first show after being named the 2026 LVMH Prize’s winner, the 28 years old Belgian designer Julie Kegels brings together a collection that seemingly drops the proportions of the female body.

data.title: Nene Royal’s to-do list: write, tour and ‘go back to school’
data.description: Rising Thai teen rock star Nene Royal, fresh off her win on “America’s Got Talent”, says she’s planning to write her own songs, tour — and “go back to school”.

data.title: Empty seats at Asian Games ‘disappointing’
data.description: NAGOYA, Japan - Fewer than 1,000 spectators watched Asian Games hosts Japan beat South Korea in the women’s football semi-final at a 50,000-capacity stadium, with a top official admitting on Wednesday that attendances at some events were “disappointing”.

data.title: Melting ice ‘transforming’ polar ocean habitats
data.description: PARIS - Climate change is increasingly reshaping the polar oceans, with Arctic waters warming rapidly, sea ice shrinking and wildlife losing habitat at both ends of the planet, a report said on Wednesday.

data.title: Julie Kegels drops the crotch low this fall
data.description: For her first show after being named the 2026 LVMH Prize’s winner, the 28 years old Belgian designer Julie Kegels brings together a collection that seemingly drops the proportions of the female body.

data.title: Whisky, big-screen TV seized from Indonesian prison ‘villas’
data.description: JAKARTA - Indonesian authorities raided a prison outside Jakarta on Wednesday where inmates have allegedly been paying to live in luxury, emptying several “villas” of furniture, bottles of alcohol and at least one big-screen TV.

data.title: Nagoya mayor says sorry for Asian Games 'inconveniences'
data.description: NAGOYA — Nagoya's mayor apologised to athletes on Wednesday for "inconveniences" at the Asian Games in the Japanese city following a string of complaints.

data.title: Lost shark becomes viral star in South Korea
data.description: SEOUL - A wayward shark has become an unlikely celebrity in South Korea, drawing massive crowds, earning plaudits from the local mayor and even moving the stock market.

data.title: Bangkok's oldest amusement park facing 6-month closure from flood damage
data.description: Bangkok's 118-acre Siam Amazing Park has announced a temporary six-month closure after nearly the entire complex suffered severe flood damage and has remained submerged for five days.
